text:
incident-bot: ALERT: service=inference-api env=production region=us-west-2 severity=page error_rate>10% over 5m, 5xx spike. Pager routed to #eng-oncall :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): I got the page, acknowledging. starting kickoff. who can own triage?

devon (sre): I can take owner. jumping in — creating war room.

maria (oncall): thanks @devon. war room: https://redwood.hq/warroom/2841122334 (pods, logs, charts attached) :link:

ash (eng-lead): pinging infra since this looks like GPU pool oom errors in the metrics. @devon any early hypotheses?

 devon (sre): hypothesis: autoscaler failing to add nodes when burst hits; observed queue growth + eviction logs. collecting logs now.

maria (oncall): paging confirmation to oncall rotation complete. notifying support and ops for customer impact assessment.

kirill (support): on it. asking CS for any user reports, will surface counts. preliminary: 3 customers reported elevated latency, 1 reported 502s.

maria (oncall): Status page draft (please review):
```
Summary: Elevated error rate (5xx) and increased latency for inference-api in us-west-2.
Impact: Some customers may experience failed or slow requests. No data loss reported.
ETA for updates: 15 minutes.
Workaround: Retry requests; transient retries may succeed.
```

ash (eng-lead): +1, include "affected endpoints: /v2/generate, /v2/chat" and note next update at +15.

kirill (support): customer notification template (short):
```
Hi — we’re investigating increased errors and latency affecting predictions in US-West. Our engineers are triaging; we’ll follow up within 15 minutes with an update. If you’re seeing production impact, reply here with request IDs.
```

maria (oncall): assigning incident severity: Sev2. owners: @devon (triage/mitigation), @ash (eng escalations), @kirill (customer comms).

devon (sre): mitigation steps I'm running now:
```
1) scale down failing pod set: kubectl -n inference scale deploy/pool-a --replicas=0
2) rollback recent config: git revert --no-commit 9f3b2a
3) force scale a healthy fallback pool: kubectl -n inference scale deploy/pool-b --replicas=8
```
will monitor error rate and queue depth.

ops-bot: automation: triggered fallback routing to pool-b, start_time=2841122360, action_id=auto-fallback-2841.

devon (sre): saw immediate drop in queue after fallback routings. errors down ~40% in the first 60s. keeping monitoring.

maria (oncall): good. please confirm whether we should post the status page now or wait for stabilization.

ash (eng-lead): post the initial status (kirill can send to customers). we should be transparent, note mitigation in progress.

kirill (support): posting to status page and notifying affected customers with the template above. will include request for request IDs to prioritize.

maria (oncall): internal comms template for other teams (paste into #general-if-needed):
```
Heads up: We’re investigating elevated 5xx rates and latency in us-west-2 for inference-api. Mitigation in progress (fallback routing). Owner: devon. Next update in 15m or on significant change. Please avoid unrelated deploys to inference services in us-west-2.
```

devon (sre): logs show a spike of OOM/kill events from node group pool-a preceeding errors. opening infra ticket for autoscaler config review.

maria (oncall): recording action items:
- devon: continue mitigation and confirm stability (monitor error rate <5% for 10m)
- ash: review recent config changes & autoscaler policy
- kirill: update customers and status page, gather reports
- ops: run postmortem template after restore

ops-bot: NOTE: runbook check completed — recommended postmortem template: /runbooks/inference-5xx.md

kirill (support): posted status page and sent notifications. link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2841122334

devon (sre): errors currently ~6.2% (down from 13.8%). keeping active mitigation. will update in 10 minutes or sooner.

maria (oncall): thanks team — handoff plan: if errors are below 5% for 10m, we’ll move to monitoring and schedule a postmortem. if they rebound, we keep this active and escalate to oncall+eng lead. next update +10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ash (eng-lead): noted. please capture any relevant logs and config diffs for PM.

devon (sre): ack. copying key logs to war room and starting a packet of artifacts.

maria (oncall): closing kickoff note here — continuing incident thread in the war room.
